name: horologium
description: What time is it in Babylon? A live, Antikythera-inspired clock for 13 calendars of the ancient world, oracle-tested.

name: gnomon
description: Design accurate sundials for any place on Earth: horizontal, vertical, equatorial, analemmatic, with scale-exact SVG/PDF export.

name: planisphere
description: Print a star wheel for any latitude and any century: precession-accurate planispheres, ready to print or laser-cut.

study.finding: Four historical star catalogues, 4,201 positions: computed places match the editors' reduction to 0.04 arcmin, and Ptolemy's stars show stellar motion.

name: tonemirror
description: See your intonation: overlay your pitch contour on a reference and practice tones and pitch accent, in the browser.

study.finding: Pitch tracking against a laryngograph, 20 speakers: 2% gross error as drawn, level with Praat and behind pYIN. The synthetic tests had said 0%.

name: errorbars
description: Error bars for LLM evals: clustered SEs, paired comparisons, leaderboards, and power analysis. Python + web calculator.

study.finding: SWE-bench Verified, 78 submissions at 60% or more: two tie at 79.2% and are level with ranks 3 to 9; 1 of 874 gaps under 3 points was significant.

name: contextscope
description: See what's actually in your LLM context window, and why your prompt cache keeps missing. Local-first, Anthropic + OpenAI.

study.finding: 12,760 real agent requests against provider usage: the Claude token estimate was 15 to 25% low; cache-read predictions now agree with Anthropic on 96 to 100%.

name: fieldproof
description: Document extraction that shows its work: every LLM-extracted field grounded to its source words, verified, and reviewable.

study.finding: 1,052 real receipts: 0.2.7 verified 78% of names with one letter changed and 42% of totals a cent off. Now neither, and OCR-repaired names go to review.

name: mcplint
description: Lint your MCP server's tools the way the model sees them: token cost, clarity, and hidden instructions.

study.finding: 418 registry MCP servers: 6.7% put over 16,000 tokens of tool definitions in the prompt. On 886 unseen servers the attack rules raise 5 errors, none an attack.

name: veil
description: Reversible PII masking for LLM calls. Mask personal data before the prompt leaves your network, then restore it in the answer.

study.finding: 32,741 real phone numbers written with a +: 0.4.4 masked 60%, 9% in France; now 99.6%. False maskings in logs and code: 11 per 1,000 words, now 0.1.

name: tracelens
description: Inspect and compare agent runs locally: operation changes, per-call evidence, tokens and estimated cost from OTLP or Jaeger JSON traces.

study.finding: 1,442 model calls from 21 instrumentation libraries: 0.3.3 showed cache-read tokens in 49 of 86, reasoning tokens in 21 of 280, tool calls in 171 of 291.

name: trainspotter
description: Automatic diagnosis of training runs from their logs: divergence, loss spikes, overfitting, LR and throughput problems.

study.finding: 537 held-out public training runs that ended well: 0.2.6 warned on 73%, now 6.9%. Of injected faults, lasting rises are caught and short bursts mostly missed.

name: ghostchars
description: See the characters you can't: catch Trojan Source bidi tricks, invisible and lookalike Unicode, and ASCII smuggling in code and LLM prompts.

study.finding: 83,494 public prompts and agent rule files: 3 carry hidden Unicode payloads, all in one jailbreak repository, and half of 0.1.5's findings hid nothing.

name: logdelta
description: Diff logs by meaning, not by bytes: masks variables, mines templates, and shows what's new in the failing run.

study.finding: 264 failed Kubernetes builds diffed against passing ones: the failing assertion is in the report in 159 of 239, in 34 lines. A raw diff takes 1,275.

name: flakemap
description: Find the flaky tests in your CI history: JUnit XML or .NET TRX from past runs in, a ranked, statistically honest flake report out.

study.finding: 4,334 Kubernetes CI builds: 310 of 314 rechecked package failures passed on the same commit, and 10 of the 16 most frequent flakes had stopped weeks before.

name: stutterscope
description: Frame-time analysis for PC gamers and reviewers: PresentMon, FrameView, CapFrameX, MangoHud and OCAT captures, in your browser.

study.finding: 8 public captures: four tools' percentile "1% low" agree to 0.13%, while mean-of-slowest and time-weighted lows sit 17% and 10% lower at the median.

name: splitscope
description: Private, in-browser LiveSplit analyzer: time save, consistency, reset survival, and Monte Carlo odds of your next PB.

study.finding: 51 real speedrun histories: the PB odds expected 484 personal bests in the next 50 attempts and 1,457 came. Low by three, yet ahead of simple baselines at 10.

name: am-i-unlucky
description: Exact drop-rate and pity math for gamers: Markov-chain pity solver, collection odds, luck percentiles. SciPy-verified.

study.finding: 26.9M logged Genshin five-stars: the soft-pity ramp holds to pull 83, and a 55% featured rate, not 50%, lifts one copy in 90 pulls from 59% to 64%.
